description: Replace an existing asset with a new version and identify all affected scenes.

inputs.asset_id: string — the ID of the asset to replace
inputs.new_path: string — file path to the replacement asset

expected_output.description: Updated asset entry and list of scenes now marked stale, pending human approval

steps.purpose: Find the current asset entry and which scenes use it
Load affected scenes to verify no timeline constraints are broken
Flag affected scenes so their renders are queued for refresh

steps.note: Output includes updated asset entry and stale scene list. Human must approve before map/assets.json is updated.
